resources.string: Mark’s personal NOVA build · Edition 3.2\n6.4.63-mark.3.2-preview · heretoecode/aos-Video

Edition 3.2 · UI update

• Compact slate navigation with active underline and search icon.
• Wide Continue watching cards with episode artwork and progress.
• Illustrated categories, documentary tile and clean poster rows.
• Playback title in the HUD, brighter compact options menu and More action.
• Classic UI remains available through Try new UI.
• Updates NOVA Preview alongside official NOVA.

Chapter picker, stats, seek previews, temporary subtitles, Up Next and scan counters remain outstanding. Streaming links remain paused.
